lzNodeTest.description: Configuration for the lz-node-test test runner, which runs each test file with node and node:test.
lzNodeTest.title: LzNodeTestOptions

testFiles.description: Glob patterns for the test files, relative to the working directory. node_modules is never searched. Defaults to Nx's test-file convention: every .spec or .test file ending in .js, .jsx, .ts or .tsx.

nodeArgs.description: Arguments for node ahead of the test file, such as --enable-source-maps. Options that add a node:test reporter or its destination are left out, as the runner uses its own reporter. Defaults to none. A test file whose tests leave something open, such as a listening server, ends once its tests and root after hooks have finished: at once if a test failed, else 30 seconds later, as a timeout in a mutant run and an error in the dry run. Close what the tests open in an after hook, or pass --test-force-exit here, as NODE_OPTIONS does not allow it; under it node:test loses errors raised after the tests and root after hooks end.

maxMemoryMB.description: The memory in MB that each process of a mutant run may hold before the runner ends it and reports the mutant as timed out. Defaults to the most memory a process of the test file held in the dry run, times 1.5, plus 1024. A dry run in which a process holds more ends as an error.

experimentalWorkerCopy.description: Experimental. Each test runner copies Stryker's sandbox once when it starts, into a folder beside it, and runs its test files there, so tests that write fixed paths inside the project no longer meet another runner's writes. Fixed ports and absolute paths still collide. Each runner start, including Stryker's restart of a runner, pays one copy. Defaults to false.
